facts.fact: NIDA says 157 institutions are connected to its registration and identification system, which lets them verify people's personal data for identity authentication and verification when serving them.
NIDA says 157 institutions, 72 government and 85 private, are connected to its identification system for verification.

TZA.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.

facts.fact: NIDA says its system lets TASAF verify beneficiaries when making electronic payments, so only intended recipients are paid.
facts.system: TASAF electronic payments verified against NIDA

TZA.note: Gives 27,458,882 registered, 87.2% of adults 18 and over by July 2026; no whole-population share, so adults-only figure is not recorded.

facts.fact: The government plans to start registering people under 18 to give them a Jamii Namba from birth, with pilots in Kilolo, Rungwe and a southern district in fiscal year 2026/27, NIDA says.
NIDA, the national authority, registers people and keeps the national register of registration and identification, and runs the system connected to 157 institutions.
facts.system: National Register of Registration and Identification of Persons

facts.fact: NIDA says 8.4 million taxpayer numbers (TIN) have been registered using national ID numbers, for the Tanzania Revenue Authority.
NIDA says TIN registration (tax), TASAF beneficiary verification (social protection) and BRELA/PBRA business registration use the national ID number.
NIDA says 23,344,265 national identification numbers have been issued and 27,458,882 people registered by July 2026.

TZA.note: TIN registration is not tax payment; nothing on electronic payment of revenue.
